notes: Babel speaks only in letters the player has caught. Every token, literal or slot, must be spelled from the level's letter pool. Slots: {T} a restored word of this level, {ANAGRAM_T} a dictionary anagram of a restored word, {W} any lexicon word, {N} noun, {V} verb, {A} adjective, {THEME} a thematic word (silence, listening, noise). Uppercase literals are fixed glue words.
